# Renew, cancel, leave

## Renew

An accreditation obtained through validation has an effective end. Renew before it, from the participant card in the frontend: the entry goes back to pending with the same validator while staying active, your agent resends an onboarding request, the validator validates again. The governance framework says what a renewal requires. The frontend flags accreditations that expire soon.

## Cancel a pending application

From the participant card: cancelling a never-validated application terminates it and refunds the escrowed fee. Cancelling a pending renewal returns the entry to validated.

## Leave

Your corporation can revoke its own accreditation. The validator and the ecosystem can too. Whatever the origin, the agent reacts the same way: the flow moves to `PARTICIPANT_REVOKED`, credentials that depended on the entry are deleted from its store and removed from the DID Document, and the agent re-publishes. A self-issued credential anchored on a revoked issuer accreditation disappears as well.

## What your backend should do

Listen to `vt.flows.state-updated` with `PARTICIPANT_REVOKED` or `PARTICIPANT_SLASHED`, and to `vpr.notification`, and stop offering the affected service. A slashed entry resumes only after the corporation repays the slashed amount from the frontend.
